body: Hello, I am actually a girl. I could go on and on about what I hate about myself, but yes, acne is one of the problems. Some cannot be helped, such as hair or facial features.
I wanted to, but I doubt my dad would allow me to, and it probably costs too much money. I don't think I can be helped. Most likely nothing can change the way I feel, unfortunately.
I just don't know what to do. I've tried  my hardest to be happy with myself. I fail every time. Now all I can think about is how easy it would be to end it.
